title: Databricks SQL version 2026.35 is now available in Preview
body:
Databricks SQL version 2026.35 is now available in the **Preview** channel. Review the following section to learn about new features and behavioral changes.

#### Aggregate arrays with `collect_union`

The `collect_union` aggregate function returns the distinct union of the elements in arrays within each group.

#### `HAVING` is evaluated before window functions in queries with generators

For queries that include generators, such as `explode`, window functions are now evaluated after the `HAVING` filter. Window results include only the rows that `HAVING` retains.

#### Policy logic is hidden in query plans by default

Query plans no longer expose row filter and column mask policy logic unless the user has the `INSPECT_POLICY_EXECUTION` metastore privilege. See [Row filters and column masks](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/filters-and-masks).

#### `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW` preserves metadata atomically

For Unity Catalog views, `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW` now performs an atomic replacement that preserves the view identity, grants, tags, and comments by default. Governed tag protections continue to apply.
